categoryDescription: Explore HCL Volt MX Iris’s simplified user interface while you build low-code and cross-channel apps. Learn about different layouts and application types that you can build.

categoryTours.title: Volt MX Orientation
categoryTours.description: Learn about the Volt MX Iris features
categoryTours.details:
This learning module is a Volt MX HIKE.  A HIKE is an interactive tour inside Volt MX Iris that guides you through step-by-step process of each module. You can access the HIKES catalog by clicking the Hike icon in the Iris toolbar.

Get a brief understanding of the Volt MX Iris features and their functionality.
